title: Charts: Prediction markets just posted their third straight record-setting week - a16z crypto
gist: Prediction market volume hit a record $14.4B in a week (up from $5-6B at the start of the year, ~10x a year ago), open interest hit $1.6B for a third straight weekly record, and non-sports volume (politics, economics, geopolitics) has grown roughly 18x since July 2025 to $3.6B/week.

insights.claim: Weekly prediction market volume hit $14.4 billion for the first time last week, up from roughly $5-6B at the start of the year.
insights.speaker: Robert Hackett
insights.so_what: Rapid multi-month volume acceleration signals a structural inflection in prediction-market adoption, not just a one-off event spike.
insights.quote: Weekly prediction market volume hit $14.4 billion for the first time last week — up from roughly $5-6B at the start of the year.
insights.locator: Weekly prediction market volume hit $14.4 billion

insights.claim: The prior all-time-high weekly volume, roughly $10 billion, had been set only a week before the $14.4 billion record.
insights.speaker: Robert Hackett
insights.so_what: Records falling week over week indicates the growth curve is still steepening rather than plateauing.
insights.quote: The previous all-time high, roughly $10B, was set only a week prior.

insights.claim: Total prediction market volume across all platforms is now more than 10x what it was a year ago.
insights.speaker: Robert Hackett
insights.so_what: A 10x year-over-year expansion frames prediction markets as one of the fastest-growing segments in crypto-adjacent activity, worth tracking for platform/token exposure.
insights.quote: Total volume across all platforms is now more than 10x what it was a year ago.

insights.claim: Open interest in prediction markets hit $1.6 billion last week, the third consecutive weekly all-time high.
insights.speaker: Robert Hackett
insights.so_what: Three straight open-interest records shows new capital is entering faster than positions resolve, a leading indicator of sustained (not just event-driven) engagement.
insights.quote: Open interest hit $1.6B last week — the third consecutive weekly all-time high.

insights.claim: Because open interest can only grow when new positions open faster than existing ones resolve, its rise reflects more money genuinely being put at stake in prediction markets, distinct from simple trading volume.
insights.speaker: Robert Hackett
insights.so_what: Investors should read open interest, not just volume, as the cleaner signal of durable capital commitment to the category.
insights.quote: Unlike volume, open interest can only grow when new positions are opened faster than existing ones resolve, so the growth seen here reflects how more money is being put at stake in these markets.
insights.locator: Unlike volume, open interest can only grow

insights.claim: Open interest has grown roughly 8x since last fall, from under $200 million to $1.6 billion.
insights.speaker: Robert Hackett
insights.so_what: An 8x rise in committed capital over roughly six to eight months quantifies the pace of institutional/retail capital inflow into the category.
insights.quote: Over that stretch, open interest has increased roughly 8x, from under $200M to $1.6B.
insights.locator: The chart has grown steadily since last fall

insights.claim: Non-sports prediction market volume (politics, economics, geopolitics, current events) hit $3.6 billion last week on Kalshi and Polymarket combined, exceeding total prediction market volume (sports included) from just a year earlier.
insights.speaker: Robert Hackett
insights.so_what: Growth is broadening beyond sports/World Cup betting into political and macro event markets, expanding the addressable use case toward information/hedging markets that could matter for macro and election-cycle trading.
insights.quote: Non-sports volume — across categories like politics, economics, geopolitics, and current events — hit $3.6B last week on Kalshi and Polymarket combined.
insights.locator: The World Cup is attracting lots of interest

insights.claim: Non-sports weekly prediction market volume was around $200 million in July 2025 and has grown roughly 18x since then, with the growth trajectory steepening sharply in the most recent month.
insights.speaker: Robert Hackett
insights.so_what: An accelerating (not just linear) 18x rise in non-sports volume within a year suggests political/economic event markets could be an emerging, still-underpriced growth vector within crypto-adjacent platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket.
insights.quote: In July 2025, non-sports weekly volume was around $200M. It has grown roughly 18x since then, with the trajectory steepening sharply this month.
